court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Judicial Magistrate Court, Paramakudi, C.C.No.9 of 2009
case_name: S.Murugan vs State Rep. By The

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: S.Murugan, Kaliammal, Jayakodi, Santhanam (husband, wife, accused)
parties.respondent_defendant: State rep. by the Sub Inspector of Police, All Women Police Station, Paramakudi, Ramanathapuram District (complainant)

facts_of_case: Petitioners are accused and charge sheeted for offence under Sections 498(A) and 506(i) of I.P.C. Defacto complainant is first petitioner's maternal uncle's daughter. She preferred complaint alleging cruelty and threat.

legal_principles.principle: The petitioners cannot take advantage of the fact that they were below marriageable age at the time of alleged marriage and claim that the marriage itself was not solemnized.
legal_principles.held: No doubt, 14 years is not marriageable age as per Section 5 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The petitioners cannot take advantage of that, and claim that marriage itself was not solemnized between the first petitioner and the defacto complainant.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the petitioners to prove that the alleged marriage was not solemnized.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, at the time of marriage, the fist petitioner might be only 14 years. No doubt, 14 years is not marriageable age as per Section 5 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

outcome.final_order: Proceeding in C.C.No.9 of 2009 against petitioners is liable to be quashed.
